items.title: DreamHost confirms data breach exposed FTP logins and webmail sessions
items.summary: DreamHost is warning of a data breach after attackers gained access to its File Manager platform for two months and stole customers' FTP/SFTP usernames and passwords. This follows the American web hosting provider and domain registrar's announcement that it suffered a cybersecurity incident requiring users to reset their email and FTP/SFTP passwords. In a data breach notification, DreamHost now says the breach extended from August 2026 to October 23, 2026, the day it was discovered.

items.title: Debian and Ubuntu APT Flaw Lets MitM Attackers Swap Verified Packages and Run Code as Root
items.summary: A flaw in APT, the package manager for Debian and Ubuntu, allows an attacker who can modify package downloads to swap a checked package for their own. The attacker's code then runs as root, according to advisories that Debian, Ubuntu, and APT's developers published on November 4. The attack needs APT to retry failed downloads, which it does by default from Debian 12 and Ubuntu 22.04 onward. Debian has released fixed versions of APT for the flaw, CVE-2026-109518. APT's developers, who call the flaw critical, say updates for Ubuntu and its Ubuntu Pro subscription service are being released. Ubun…

items.title: Researchers Uncover Prompt Adware Hidden in OpenAI Codex Jailbreak Toolkit
items.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of an OpenAI Codex jailbreak bundle that's designed to modify an artificial intelligence (AI) agent's trusted instructions to insert advertisements for a third-party AI gateway. The phenomenon has been codenamed prompt adware by Check Point Research. Called Haiou (meaning Seagull in Chinese), the jailbreak modifies OpenAI Codex's configuration files to inject advertisements for the jailbreak author's website into subsequent agent responses. "The advertised service is an opaque, OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway, a middleware between an application a…

items.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added a security flaw in WordPress Core to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. The high-severity vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-119977 (CVSS score: 8.1), is a case of Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition that could be exploited to achieve arbitrary code execution on affected servers. Patches for the flaw were released late last month. "WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticate…

items.title: Cyberattack disrupts blood storage refrigeration systems in France
items.summary: France's national blood service has confirmed that a cyberattack targeting a refrigeration equipment provider raised temperature and defrost settings at three of its facilities, threatening stored blood products. The French Blood Establishment (Établissement français du sang or EFS), which manages blood collection, processing, and distribution across France, said the incident occurred on November 2 and affected systems used to monitor and control cold-storage chambers. According to a statement published on November 3, EFS was not directly targeted in the cyberattack, but was instead its refrig…

items.title: Google Calendar phishing campaign hijacks sessions, bypasses MFA
items.summary: Since mid-August 2026, a phishing operation has been harvesting live Google sessions from corporate users. Every signal defenders usually rely on to judge a link returned a reassuring answer, and the operator built the chain that way on purpose. Material Security’s Threat Research team identified the campaign and has taken down hundreds of domains used by attackers in what they have dubbed Operation CloudFire. Here’s what they learned along the way.

items.title: Hackers use n-day exploits in zero-click attacks on iOS, Android devices
items.summary: A large-scale watering hole attack associated with Russian hackers has been targeting iOS and Android users visiting compromised sites or fake ones impersonating legitimate portals. The campaign used multiple high-profile websites in the U.S., Ukraine, the Czech Republic, and Bulgaria that delivered the same payload for profiling visitors and their devices. This initial stage allows the attacker to determine the browser version to deploy "platform-specific n-day exploit chains without user interaction."

items.title: Fake-download campaign uses trojanized installers to deliver monetization payloads
items.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence has identified an evolving fake-download campaign targeting users searching for cracked commercial software, free games, activators, plugins, and unofficial utilities. The campaign uses trojanized Inno Setup-style installers to distribute multiple monetized software payloads, referred to by the delivery system as “offers”, during a single installation session. Our investigation found that the installers use a per-offer callback and status-tracking model to manage delivery and record installation outcomes. We confirmed three downstream monetization branches that tr…

items.title: Chrome 157 fixes 213 security issues, including 7 critical flaws
items.summary: On November 3, Google issued Chrome 157 to the stable channel for Windows, Mac and Linux. The update is rolling out over the coming days and weeks. Most users are on Chrome’s Stable channel. The desktop update brings Chrome to versions 157.0.8103.38/.39 for Windows and Mac and 157.0.8103.38 for Linux. It includes 213 security fixes, including seven vulnerabilities rated Critical by Google. Chrome for Android was also updated to 157.0.8103.38. It will become available on Google Play over the coming days.

items.title: HYFLOCK Ransomware Evolves with New Builds and Encryption Weaknesses
items.summary: Four ransomware generations. Six months of development. Eight victim claims published in a single day. HYFLOCK spent much of 2026 building its ransomware operation, recruiting participants through underground forums and promoting increasingly sophisticated attack capabilities. By October, the group had begun publicly naming victims, and its ransomware had undergone significant changes. Through threat hunting, Check Point Exposure Management researchers identified updated HYFLOCK ransomware builds and traced their development from April through October. The investigation revealed changes in how…

items.title: Mikä ihmeen nas? Purimme laitteen, johon voi lisätä kymmeniä teratavuja tallennustilaa
items.summary: Nas eli verkkolevy on käytännössä tietokone, joka on suunniteltu ja valmistettu toimimaan tietovarastona. Network attached storage (nas) kääntyy suomeksi verkkolevyksi tai verkkotallentimeksi. Se on laite, jossa on yleensä teratavuittain tallennustilaa. Nasille voi esimerkiksi varmuuskopioida kuvat ja videot puhelimesta tai säilöä tärkeitä dokumentteja. Nimityksestään huolimatta nasin ei tarvitse edes olla verkkoyhteydessä toimiakseen, vaan sitä voi käyttää myös usb-kaapelin avulla. Maksuton uutiskirje kokoaa kahdesti viikossa hyödyllisimmät testit, oppaat, vinkit ja digiuutiset.
